caseName: United Electrical, Radio & Machine Workers v. Goodman Manufacturing Co.
caseNameFull: United Electrical, Radio and Machine Workers of America (UE) v. Goodman Manufacturing Co.
attorneys: Basil R. Pollitt for petitioners. Oscar H. Davis, then Acting Solicitor General, Theophil C. Kammholz, Dominick L. Manoli and Samuel M. Singer for the National Labor Relations Board, and Charles Aaron for the Goodman Manufacturing Co., respondents.

opinions.text: C. A. 7th Cir. Motion to use the certified record in case No. 775, October Term, 1955, as a part of the record in this case granted. Certiorari denied.
